title: Contact Us — The National Days of Prayer Movement in Europe
description: Contact the National Days of Prayer Movement in Europe. Enquiries from churches, religious communities, parliamentarians, public institutions and media.
heroLede: Whether you represent a church, a religious community, a public institution or a group of citizens — we would be glad to hear from you.
cardRole: The National Days of Prayer Movement in Europe
cardNote: Correspondence is handled by the board of the country concerned. Please write in English, or in the language of that country.

blocks.title: For churches and religious communities
blocks.text: We help form interdenominational steering committees, share materials for a first national gathering, and connect you with communities in other countries that have already begun.

blocks.title: For parliamentarians and public institutions
blocks.text: We provide the legal precedents — Public Law 100-307 in the United States and the 2025 resolution of the Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine — together with model legislative language adaptable to national procedure.

mediaText: Photographs, the movement’s brochure and interview requests: please write to info@nationaldayofprayer.eu with “Media” in the subject line.
formNote: Your message opens in your email client addressed to the movement’s board. Nothing is stored on this website.
pullQuote: A National Day of Prayer offers an opportunity for millions of people to unite in seeking God’s guidance, praying for peace, wisdom for leaders, protection for their nations, and blessings for future generations.
pullQuoteCite: The National Days of Prayer Movement in Europe
